facts.fact: Allie 觉得 Sophie 的友善态度真诚而不设防，自己也不由自主地笑了。
facts.anchor: The princess’s friendly manner was immediate and disarming in its sincerity, and I found myself smiling without effort.

facts.fact: Gregory 向国王一方介绍自己的妹妹 Sophie 公主。
Allie 瞪了国王一眼，厉声质问到底谁在谈判——她还是国王。
facts.anchor: I shot him a pointed look and snapped, “Who’s negotiating? You or me?”

facts.fact: Allie 不愿深究国王过去八个月是否对其他国家犯下暴行。
facts.anchor: whether or not he was truly responsible for any atrocities committed against other kingdoms in the past eight months

facts.fact: Sophie 跪在伤者旁，双手发出微光，替他们缝合伤口、包扎较深的伤口。
facts.anchor: her hands glowing faintly as she knelt beside each patient, knitting wounds, wrapping bandages for deeper cuts

facts.fact: Sophie 说这并不难猜，她仅凭今早的观察就推断出 Allie 戴着国王的神秘之心。
facts.anchor: It wasn’t hard to guess. I’ve only observed your interactions this morning

facts.fact: Sophie 说姐姐被杀，哥哥 Gregory 是最好的人却一直自责。
facts.anchor: when our sister was…killed. My brother is a good man. He is the best man I know. But he blames himself.

facts.fact: Sophie 说红皇后迫使所有人服从她的命令，统治整片大地数百年。
facts.anchor: Everyone was compelled to do her bidding, and she ruled over the entire land for centuries.
